mapper.sql: a.id, a.grp_id, (SELECT grp_nm FROM SYS_DEPT_GRP b WHERE CONVERT(b.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(a.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS grp_nm, (SELECT fnm FROM SYS_USER c WHERE c.id = a.id) AS fnm, (SELECT eml FROM SYS_USER c WHERE c.id = a.id) AS eml, a.user_id, a.inst_cd AS inst_cd, (SELECT inst_nm FROM SYS_INST WHERE CONVERT(inst_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(a.inst_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) AS inst_nm, a.sys_gen_dt AS sys_crt_dt, a.sys_crt_usr_id, a.sys_mdfcn_dt AS sys_upd_dt, a.sys_mdfr_id AS sys_upd_usr_id

where.if: AND a.id IN (SELECT id FROM SYS_USER WHERE eml = #{eml})
AND a.id IN (SELECT id FROM SYS_USER WHERE eml LIKE CONCAT('%', #{_eml}, '%'))

mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT dg.up_grp_id FROM SYS_DEPT_GRP dg WHERE CONVERT(dg.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(#{grp_id} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci), #{grp_id} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_USER_GRP( id, grp_id, user_up_grp_id, user_id, inst_cd, sys_gen_dt, sys_crt_usr_id , sys_mdfcn_dt , sys_mdfr_id ) VALUES( #{id}, #{grp_id}, , #{user_id}, #{inst_cd}, NOW(), #{sys_crt_usr_id} , #{sys_upd_dt} , #{sys_upd_usr_id} )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO SYS_USER_GRP ( id, grp_id, user_up_grp_id, user_id, inst_cd, sys_gen_dt, sys_crt_usr_id, sys_mdfcn_dt, sys_mdfr_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{grp_id}, , #{user_id}, #{inst_cd}, NOW(), #{sys_crt_usr_id}, #{sys_upd_dt}, NULL, #{sys_upd_usr_id} NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_up_grp_id = VALUES(user_up_grp_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), inst_cd = VALUES(inst_cd), sys_mdfcn_dt = NOW(), sys_mdfr_id = VALUES(sys_mdfr_id)
